segments.he: זֶה מִדְרָשׁ דָּרַשׁ רַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר לִפְנֵי חֲכָמִים כּוּ׳.
segments.en: § The Gemara returns to the mishna: «This exposition was expounded» by «Rabbi Elazar» ben Azarya «before the Sages» in the vineyard of Yavne: Just as the sons inherit only after the father’s death, so too, the daughters are sustained from his property only after their father’s death.
